authored_inputs.blue_blanket_damage_mapping: Authored verification mapping based on the documented EU-DEMO example 10.2 dpa/FPY scaled to the shared 525 MW fusion boundary, then multiplied by the authored blanket lifetime. It does not establish FARIS fluence-to-DPA equivalence or physical validation.
authored_inputs.blue_out_of_scope_sentinels: Authored high damage/fluence thresholds for divertor, vessel, and TF to keep this restricted case focused on blanket maintenance; these are not material limits.

provenance.archived_faris_blanket_campaign_interval: FARIS archived fixed blanket event: next start minus previous event end in references/maintenance-0.2-parity.json, design no-port__breeder. Simulation output, not a measurement.
provenance.blanket_lifetime_full_power_years: Authored by dividing the archived campaign interval by a 365.25-day year. This is a verification schedule interval, not inferred material service life.
provenance.calendar_horizon_years: Authored as two (blanket lifetime + fixed replacement duration) cycles.
provenance.fixed_blanket_replacement_days: Authored 60-day work duration from the archived FARIS fixed blanket histories; not measured maintenance time.
provenance.fusion_power_mw: 525 MW from the authored FARIS cold-reference scenario, used as a shared nominal fusion-power boundary.
provenance.net_electric_normalization_mw: Authored shared reporting normalization only; neither availability submodel calculates net electric power.
provenance.parallel_remote_handling_systems: Authored single-system boundary; bluemira LifeCycle has no corresponding native remote-handling count input, so no throughput inference is made.
provenance.unplanned_unavailability: Authored deterministic zero-unplanned verification assumption, not an empirical reliability estimate. PROCESS uses explicit zero fractions; bluemira uses its documented strategy extension point with a zero distribution and fails if it is asked to represent positive unplanned downtime.

faris_reference.role: Separate historical FARIS native reference output; its 30-year results are reported beside, but not normalized as though they shared the two-cycle peer horizon.

match_rule: Report a matched controlled peer baseline only if the native outputs show the authored horizon, two blanket replacements, zero unplanned downtime, and agreement of the two availability fractions within 1e-6. Otherwise report incomplete and preserve the native outputs/reason. Any MWh(e) figure is only the shared authored 500 MW(e) normalization times each peer's native full-power years; it is not peer-native electric generation.

bluemira.api: bluemira.fuel_cycle.lifecycle.LifeCycle.make_timeline() using native damage-governed maintenance and the documented OperationalAvailabilityStrategy.generate_distribution extension point.
bluemira.python: Set by the coordinator at run time

process.api: process.models.availability.Availability.run(WARD_TAYLOR), with data.ife.ife=1 and the explicit authored lives above. No reactor physics or optimization run.
process.python: Set by the coordinator at run time

scope: Authored verification-only blanket availability control. It exercises the native PROCESS Ward-Taylor availability submodel and native bluemira LifeCycle timeline. It is not experimental validation, a whole-plant model, or measured plant data.
